description:
Add comprehensive validation and error handling to ensure query plan data
integrity and robustness against malformed inputs. Implement validation at
multiple layers: post-parse, pre-serialization, and post-deserialization.

**Problems Addressed**:
- No validation of parsed plan tree structure (could have cycles, orphans)
- Fingerprints become stale after tree mutations (not validated)
- Parser errors lack context (no line numbers, sample data)
- Malformed plans cause silent failures or cryptic errors
